method: Three surfaces. (bundle) servers/office-suite/dist/index.js registered as ONE server named "office" in /private/tmp/uv4/mcp.json, fresh XDG_DATA_HOME=/private/tmp/uv4/data + XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/private/tmp/uv4/cfg, MCP_LICENSE_KEY=""; four prompts in ONE conversation via --session-id then --resume, --strict-mcp-config --model sonnet --output-format stream-json --verbose --max-turns 14, allowlist written out per tool name (50 x mcp__office__<tool>) because --allowedTools "mcp__*" no longer grants anything (D-E4). (remote) claude mcp add --transport http --scope local tt/inv against https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/{time-tracker,invoice} with Authorization: Bearer <token from GET https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token>, run from /private/tmp/uv5, local scope removed afterwards. (stdio) the four round-2 sub-3 scenarios re-run against /private/tmp/uv2/mcp.json with the round-2 data dir intact, plus expense s1 against a fresh /private/tmp/uv3b. Tool-call counts exclude the client's own ToolSearch schema lookups.

scenarios.note: mcp__office__timer_start, one call. Bundle resolved all five children at startup: 'proxying [time-tracker, price-tracker, spreadsheet, invoice, expense-tracker], 48 tools' (50 exposed with license_status/license_activate).

scenarios.prompt: Stop it, log 2.5 more hours for Acme at 90 EUR yesterday, and log the 61.50 EUR Media Markt USB hub receipt for Acme as billable.
scenarios.note: timer_stop -> entry_add -> expense_add, three servers in one turn, no cross-server confusion. 2.5 h at EUR 90/h = EUR 225.00 correct. Expense stored EUR 61.50 with no VAT split; the model said so unprompted ('uncategorised, no VAT split').

scenarios.prompt: Now invoice Acme for this week's hours and the rebillable expenses, 23% VAT, due in 14 days, PDF.
scenarios.note: entry_list -> invoice_summary -> expense_to_invoice -> invoice_create. invoice_create returned 'Error: no business profile yet. Call business_set first.' No invoice, no PDF, the turn ended asking the user for business details. Two defects surfaced here: expense_to_invoice emitted unit_price 61.50 / tax_rate 0 (D-R3, gross rebilled as net), and it set marked_rebilled: true even though the invoice was never created (D-R4).

scenarios.prompt: What did I spend this month and what is still unbilled?
scenarios.note: expense_summary -> expense_list -> report. Spend EUR 61.50 correct. Unbilled hours EUR 225.00 correct. The model had to spend a paragraph explaining that the expense shows as rebilled although no invoice exists (the D-R4 state it created in a3). Correct and honest, but the answer describes a corrupted ledger.

scenarios.prompt: Start a timer for Remote Co
scenarios.note: mcp__tt__timer_start over HTTP. FIRST attempt scored 0: the init line reported [{"name":"tt","status":"pending"},{"name":"inv","status":"pending"}] and zero mcp__ tools in the session tool list, so the model answered with no tools at all ('Could you clarify what you mean by Remote Co?'). Second attempt: tt 'connected', 13 tools present, correct. See D-R5.

scenarios.prompt: What timer is running and stop it (NEW session)
scenarios.note: Separate --session-id, no conversation history. timer_status -> timer_stop: 'Timer for Remote Co was running (started 14:30:15 UTC, ran 23 seconds). Stopped and logged as entry a4a7db17.' State persisted server-side across sessions, which is the property the hosted surface exists for.

scenarios.prompt: Invoice Remote Co for 3 hours at 100 USD, give me the document link
scenarios.note: invoice_from_hours refused: no business profile. No invoice, no link. Same wall as a3, on a different surface and a different transport, from a first-session user. See D-R2.

scenarios.prompt: (follow-up, business supplied) My business is Zovo Studio ... Now invoice Remote Co for 3 hours at 100 USD and give me the document link.
scenarios.note: business_set -> invoice_from_hours -> invoice_pdf. INV-2026-0001, 3 h x USD 100 = USD 300.00, due 2026-09-16. Link https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/download/81ef3dda6579d2113f6eb6a73ac53c0b returns HTTP 200, 1693 bytes, Content-Type text/html (a print-ready A4 HTML invoice, not application/pdf) - see D-R6. Model relayed the free-tier watermark and the bare-client warning.

scenarios.prompt: What does this cost right now: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html
scenarios.note: WebFetch first, then mcp__price-tracker__price_check. The answer the user read is the server's: GBP 51.77 plus the 'confidence low (regex fallback)' caveat. D-4 half-closed: the server no longer loses the answer, only the first call.

scenarios.prompt: How much do I bill Acme this week? Give me invoice lines.
scenarios.note: invoice_summary answered on the free tier (D-11 fixed), 35.6 s -> 23.5 s, 7 calls -> 5. Table: Design review 2.50 h, EUR 90.00/h, EUR 225.00, total EUR 225.00. The 8-second stray entry is shown as 0.00 h and explained rather than silently folded in.

scenarios.prompt: Which rep sold the most units in the North region? Top 5 with totals. (file path given in the prompt)
scenarios.note: sheet_info -> sheet_query. Turing 650, Hopper 567, Linus T 551, Lovelace 486, Liskov 290 - exactly ground truth. No self-added [Status]="Closed" filter this time. D-10 not reproduced. Prompt deviation: the absolute xlsx path was included in the prompt this round.

scenarios.prompt: I paid 61.50 EUR at Media Markt for a USB hub today, for the Acme project, it's billable.
scenarios.note: expense_add in one call, fresh data dir. EUR 61.50, 2026-09-02, project Acme, billable, note 'USB hub'. VAT still 0% with the honest 'net = gross with EUR 0 VAT recorded' line and an offer to set a default. Unchanged from round 2 (D-E1 stands as a disclosed limitation).

hours.where: a2 entry_add, a3 invoice_summary, a4 report

expense_net.detail: The expense was stored with no VAT rate (none was named at expense_add time), so expense_to_invoice rebilled the gross 61.50 as if it were net. Applying the requested 23% on the invoice would have charged EUR 75.65 on a EUR 61.50 receipt. Setting expense_settings {default_vat_rate: 23} afterwards does NOT re-split stored expenses: a direct probe with include_rebilled:true still returned unit_price 61.5, tax_rate 0, total_net 'EUR 61.50'.

invoice_total.observed: not produced in conversation (a3 blocked on business_set); direct probe with correct inputs produced EUR 338.25
invoice_total.detail: invoice_create {items:[{2.5 x 90},{1 x 50}]} against a business with default_tax_rate 23 -> subtotal EUR 275.00, tax 23%, total EUR 338.25, INV-2026-0003. Exact. The same call against a business where default_tax_rate had been left at 0 returned EUR 275.00 with tax_rate '0%' on both lines and no warning.

cross_server_arithmetic.left_the_bundle_detail: Across all four bundle turns every tool call was mcp__office__*: timer_start, timer_stop, entry_add, expense_add, entry_list, invoice_summary, expense_to_invoice, invoice_create, expense_summary, expense_list, report. No Bash, no python, no WebFetch, no Read/Write. The only non-office calls were the client's own ToolSearch schema lookups (6 across the four turns).

defects.title: invoice_summary blends rates across entries and prints an average that is nobody's rate
defects.repro: In the bundle run, project Acme had one 0.01 h entry with no rate and one 2.50 h entry at EUR 90.00. Both have no task, so both fall into the same '(no task)' group, and invoice_summary printed: '(no task) 2.50 EUR 89.82 EUR 225.00'. 225.00 / 2.505 = 89.82. The amount is right, the rate is a number the user never agreed to and cannot put on an invoice. The stdio run (out/r3_tt4.jsonl) shows the correct behaviour when the entries carry different tasks: 'Design review 2.50 EUR 90.00 EUR 225.00' and a separate '(no task) 0.00 - -' row.
defects.fix_direction: group by (task, rate, currency), not task alone; or print the rate only when every entry in the group shares it, and '-' otherwise, which the zero-rate row already does.

defects.title: every invoicing path dead-ends on a missing business profile, and only after the work is done
defects.repro: bundle a3 and remote b3, two surfaces, two transports, both first sessions. invoice_create -> 'Error: no business profile yet. Call business_set first.' In a3 this arrived after entry_list, invoice_summary and expense_to_invoice had already run (47.7 s), and expense_to_invoice had already mutated the ledger. The model cannot invent a business name, so the turn always ends as a question and the user gets nothing.
defects.fix_direction: either let invoice_create proceed with a placeholder issuer and a loud note (the tool already does exactly this for an unknown client), or declare the prerequisite in the description of every invoice-producing tool so the model asks first instead of last.

defects.title: expense_to_invoice rebills a VAT-inclusive receipt as a net line
defects.repro: expense_add {amount: 61.50, currency: EUR} with no vat_rate stores net = gross = 61.50. expense_to_invoice then emits {unit_price: 61.5, tax_rate: 0} with total_net 'EUR 61.50'. Put on an invoice at the 23% the user asked for, that bills EUR 75.65 for a EUR 61.50 purchase. Probe: node /private/tmp/uv4/probe4.mjs '{"name":"expense_to_invoice","args":{"project":"Acme","from":"2026-09-01","to":"2026-09-02","include_rebilled":true}}'.
defects.fix_direction: expense_to_invoice should refuse, or warn in the payload, when a rebilled expense has vat_rate 0 in a jurisdiction default that is non-zero; and it should carry the gross figure alongside so the caller can see whether the number is net or gross. Related: expense_settings {default_vat_rate} is not retroactive and does not say so.

defects.title: expense_to_invoice marks expenses rebilled before any invoice exists
defects.repro: bundle a3: expense_to_invoice returned marked_rebilled: true, then invoice_create failed with the business-profile error. The expense is now flagged as billed and will not resurface in the next expense_to_invoice run. a4 read the ledger back and reported 'EUR 0 shows as pending, but that's misleading'. The model caught it; a user reading only a4's first line would not.
defects.fix_direction: add a dry_run default, or an explicit invoice_number argument, so the rebilled flag is only set once a line item is attached to a created invoice.

defects.title: first HTTP connection is not ready at session start, so the model runs with zero tools
defects.repro: Immediately after claude mcp add --transport http, the first claude -p run emitted a system/init line with [{"name":"tt","status":"pending"},{"name":"inv","status":"pending"}] and no mcp__ entries in the tools array. The model answered 'Could you clarify what you mean by Remote Co?' with 0 tool calls and 10.5 s. The identical command 60 s later showed tt 'connected', 13 tools, and worked. The stdio surface never does this.
defects.fix_direction: probably a cold start on the hosted side rather than a client bug: a warm handshake or a faster initialize response would remove it. Whatever the cause, the user's very first hosted prompt is the one that fails, which is the worst possible one to lose.

defects.title: the 'document link' from invoice_pdf serves text/html, not a PDF
defects.repro: curl -sI https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/download/81ef3dda6579d2113f6eb6a73ac53c0b -> HTTP 200, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8, 1693 bytes. The body is a complete A4 print stylesheet invoice ('<title>Invoice INV-2026-0001</title>', @page{size:A4;margin:18mm}), so it prints correctly, but the model called it a PDF and a user who saves it gets .html.
defects.fix_direction: either serve the rendered PDF at that URL, or have the tool response call it a printable invoice page so the model does not promise a PDF.

defects.title: business_set silently drops an unrecognised tax_rate key and the invoice comes out with no VAT
defects.repro: business_set {name:'Zovo Studio', tax_rate: 23} succeeds and echoes a profile containing default_tax_rate: 0 - the wrong key was accepted and thrown away. invoice_create then produced INV-2026-0001 with tax_rate '0%' on every line and total EUR 275.00 where EUR 338.25 was intended, with no warning anywhere. Same call with default_tax_rate: 23 -> tax 23%, total EUR 338.25 (INV-2026-0003).
defects.fix_direction: the field is named default_tax_rate while the user and the model both say 'tax rate'; accept tax_rate/vat_rate as aliases, or make the schema strict so an unknown key errors instead of vanishing. A silently zero VAT on a produced invoice is the most expensive class of quiet failure in this repo.

pt1.why: price_check is now called and its answer is the one reported, though WebFetch still goes first.

tt4.why: D-11 closed: invoice_summary answers on free. 7 calls / 35.6 s -> 5 calls / 23.5 s.

ss2.why: D-10 not reproduced: no self-added Status filter, ranking matches ground truth exactly.

s1.why: unchanged; VAT still 0 by design when the user names no rate, and the tool says so.

remote.note: b1 first attempt (0) excluded from the score and recorded as D-R5; b3b counted.
